title: 🏰 I’m Building My Own Medieval RTS Game — Kingdoms of Verdantia!
author: KingtopGames
selftext:
**🏰 I’m Building My Own Medieval RTS Game — Kingdoms of Verdantia!**

What if your villagers didn't just stand around waiting for commands? What if they built homes, gathered resources, survived, expanded their kingdom, and fought back against invading trolls?

I'm developing **Kingdoms of Verdantia**, an indie medieval strategy game featuring:

⚔️ Real-time kingdom building

🌲 Resource gathering & survival

🏘️ Villagers with their own lives

🛡️ Armies, battles & defense

👹 Troll raids and enemy factions

🌍 A massive world to explore and expand

I'm building this game as an indie developer, and I'd love to hear what the RTS community thinks!

**What feature would make YOU want to play this game?**

Gameplay / development footage: https://youtu.be/AGoTESB84zk?si=clspYR58HxFgRev8

\#IndieGame #GameDev #RTS #StrategyGames #Unity #MedievalGame #IndieDeveloper

I used AI as a development assistant for parts of Kingdoms of Verdantia, helping with coding, brainstorming gameplay mechanics, debugging, and creating some visual assets. However, I’m the one designing the game, making decisions, integrating everything into Unity, testing mechanics, and shaping the overall gameplay. AI is a tool in my development process, not a replacement for building the game myself.
